description: User login to obtain session for subsequent operations
guidance: Call /v1/cl/user/login using POST method with a JSON body and a timestamp query parameter. The timestamp should be a Unix timestamp, valid within 10 minutes.

input.name: body
input.description: Request body containing user login information

output.name: response
output.description: Response object containing the session details

description: Create DDoS attack flow template for UDP flood
guidance: Call /v1/cl/ddos/attack/flow/create to create a UDP flood attack flow template with a peak of 500Mbps, lasting for 60 seconds, targeting IP 11.0.0.1/24. The request must include a valid timestamp and session_id.

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

input.name: body
input.description: Details of the attack flow to be created, including type, peak, duration, and target IP

output.name: response_body
output.description: Response body from the API call

description: 验证DDoS攻击流量模板是否有效
guidance: 本步骤旨在通过调用/v1/cl/ddos/attack/flow/check接口来检查先前创建的DDoS攻击流量模板的有效性。请使用POST方法，并确保timestamp参数为一个有效的Unix时间戳，且在请求发出后的10分钟内有效。同时，需要提供一个session_id作为查询参数。

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

input.name: body
input.description: AttackFlowCheckRequest object containing details of the DDoS attack flow to be checked.

output.name: response
output.description: AttackFlowCheckResponse object indicating the result of the DDoS attack flow check.

description: Save DDoS attack flow template for future use
guidance: Call /v1/cl/ddos/attack/flow/save to save a created and validated DDoS attack flow template. This step requires a valid session_id obtained from a previous login, and the timestamp must be a Unix timestamp that is not older than 10 minutes.

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: Unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

input.name: body
input.description: Request body for saving DDoS attack flow template

output.name: response
output.description: Response after saving DDoS attack flow template

description: Run a pre-configured DDoS attack testcase
guidance: This step aims to execute a pre-configured DDoS attack testcase. Use POST method to call /v1/cl/testcase/run, ensure the timestamp is within 10 minutes of the current time, and provide a valid session_id.

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

input.name: body
input.description: Request body for running a testcase

description: Search real-time category statistics of the specified test case instance
guidance: Call /v1/cl/stats/category/search with POST method to get real-time statistics. Ensure the timestamp is within a 10-minute validity window and use an allocated session ID for authentication.

description: 查询指定测试用例实例的历史统计数据
guidance: 根据上一步获取到的统计类别ID，调用/v1/cl/stats/search接口来查询详细的统计数据。使用POST方法，并确保提供有效的时间戳（有效期为10分钟）和会话ID作为查询参数。请求体中需要包含StatsSearchRequest对象。

output.name: response_body
output.description: Response body containing the result of the stats search request

description: User logout to safely end the current session
guidance: Call /v1/cl/user/logout to log out the user, which requires a valid session_id and timestamp. The timestamp should be a Unix timestamp that is not older than 10 minutes.

input.name: SESSION_ID
input.description: allocated session id for the user

input.name: TIMESTAMP
input.description: unix timestamp, expired in 10 minutes, type is int

input.name: body
input.description: Request body for the logout operation

output.name: response
output.description: The response object from the server
